The core accusation is the theft of trade secrets involving OpenAI's alleged conspiracy.

bullet_points: Japan has developed a new method for lithium recovery from spent EV batteries.
The technology boasts a high recovery rate, capable of extracting up to 90% of the lithium.
This development is highly relevant to sustainable energy and the EV battery recycling industry.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured significant funding, raising $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
The company boasts a substantial user base, currently serving 8.9 million developers.
The news highlights the growing commercial and developer adoption of open-source large language models (LLMs) via Ollama.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted on Apple Silicon when running through Ollama 0.31.
The speed improvement is achieved via Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) leveraging the MLX framework.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using its MLX engine.
The performance boost translates to higher quality model responses.
Users benefit from faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these personal AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It integrates native support for Ollama, leveraging local LLMs for privacy and control.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for enhanced performance.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, optimizing local AI inference.
The feature is currently available in a preview build, indicating ongoing development.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It connects these apps to local AI coding agents.
A key feature is that all AI processing runs entirely on the user's local device.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The paper moves beyond surface-level input-output analysis of LLM-as-Judge bias to investigate the underlying representation-level causes within the judge's hidden state.
It provides a mechanistic interpretability account of bias, offering a complementary and operationally useful perspective to existing methods.
The research is robust, testing across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine different benchmarks.

stories.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
stories.author: Juan Carlos Niebles
bullet_points: Addresses the 'black box' problem in Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) for Question Answering (QA).
Proposes Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering (E-VQA) to enforce verifiable visual grounding for answers.
Aims to overcome limitations of current methods, such as sparse bounding boxes, in handling complex video dynamics like occlusions.

stories.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
stories.author: Afshin Dehghan
bullet_points: Introduces MM-ToolSandBox, a new benchmark and evaluation framework specifically for visually grounded tool-calling agents.
The framework supports complex, stateful tasks involving 500+ tools across 16 application domains, handling multi-image and multi-turn interactions.
It addresses realistic conversational challenges such as goal revisions, error corrections, and state mutations during agent execution.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The research moves beyond input-output level analysis of LLM-as-judge bias to provide a mechanistic interpretability account within the judge's hidden state.
It offers a complementary and operationally useful perspective on bias compared to traditional prompt-level mitigation strategies.
The study is robust, involving seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks to validate its findings.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The research moves beyond traditional input-output analysis of LLM-as-judge bias to investigate biases within the model's internal hidden states (representation-level account).
It provides a mechanistic interpretability framework to explain *why* LLMs exhibit judging biases, offering a deeper technical understanding.
The study is highly empirical, testing across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks, lending strong validity to its findings.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: The first sunlight reflecting space mirror has been cleared for launch
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Reflect Orbital is cleared to launch its first space mirror prototype.
The technology aims to redirect sunlight to Earth during nighttime hours.
The FCC has authorized the startup to operate the satellite in low-Earth orbit.

stories.title: Let’s build a children’s public internet
stories.author: Adi Robertson
bullet_points: Growing consensus that the current internet environment is detrimental to children (addiction, mental health risks, safety concerns).
Several nations are implementing stricter regulations, including age verification mandates or outright bans for minors.
The US House of Representatives has recently taken action regarding these concerns, signaling legislative movement on the issue.

stories.title: New York becomes the first state to enact a data center moratorium
stories.author: Lauren Feiner
bullet_points: New York has enacted the nation's first statewide moratorium on new hyperscale data centers.
The current order blocks new environmental permits for these large-scale data facilities.
Further legislation to potentially restrict data center developments is pending the Governor's signature.

stories.title: Microsoft tests Windows Search without all the ads and fluff
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Microsoft is testing a cleaner version of the Windows 11 search menu.
The new version removes recommended content and advertisements from the search interface.
The feature is being rolled out to Windows Insiders in the Experimental channel to improve user trust.

stories.title: Apple’s public betas for iOS 27 and more are out now
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Public betas for iOS 27 and other major OS updates have been released by Apple.
The headline feature is the revamped, AI-powered Siri, which is noted as functional.
The updates are scheduled for a public launch later this fall.

stories.title: Siri AI makes the Apple Watch finally feel like a wrist computer
stories.author: Victoria Song
bullet_points: watchOS 27 developer beta introduces significant improvements to Siri on the Apple Watch.
The update aims to transform the Apple Watch from a basic utility into a more capable 'wrist computer' via AI enhancements.
The article suggests Siri's functionality has historically been underutilized, indicating a potential shift in user interaction.

stories.title: SpaceX is gearing up for Starship's 13th test flight later this week
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX is preparing for the 13th test flight of its Starship vehicle.
The upcoming flight is designed to subject Starship to increased operational pressure.
The mission will also involve testing new Starlink satellites in orbit.

stories.title: The US government warns that Russia state hackers are coming after your router
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: CISA has issued a warning regarding cyber threats targeting residential routers.
The threat specifically involves state-sponsored hackers originating from Russia.
The warning is issued in the context of increasing use of residential proxies.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone strikes forced Russia to stop shipping in vital sea corridor
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Ukrainian drone attacks successfully disrupted Russian maritime operations.
The Sea of Azov shipping corridor experienced a halt in Russian transport within a week.
The incident highlights the tactical impact of drone technology in modern military logistics.

stories.title: Apple and Samsung benefit as memory shortage pushes smartphone shipments to historic lows
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Smartphone shipments are declining to historic lows.
The primary cause is attributed to component shortages and economic uncertainty.
Despite market headwinds, major players like Apple and Samsung are maintaining sales.

stories.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Metacognition is identified as a critical, foundational component for advanced intelligence in AI systems.
Despite LLM progress, the extent and method of achieving effective metacognitive abilities in these models remain unclear.
The research highlights opportunities for integrating metacognition to enhance AI's capabilities in learning and decision-making.

stories.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
stories.author: Thomas Hofmann
bullet_points: Presents a theoretical framework to explain how Transformer models develop inductive reasoning capabilities.
Unifies several existing synthetic inductive tasks (like in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning) into a generalized class.
The research theoretically proves that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined within this generalized task class.

stories.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
stories.author: Preston Culbertson
bullet_points: Introduces REGRIND, a new minimalist pipeline for dexterous manipulation.
Addresses the challenge of applying simple motion retargeting recipes to complex, contact-rich manipulation tasks.
Utilizes Reinforcement Learning (RL) guided by motion retargeting to learn delicate force and contact regulation.

stories.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
stories.author: Romain Amigon
bullet_points: Proposes a new frugal Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework to reduce computational costs.
Combines a global macro-search using a Transformer controller (trained via RL) with local micro-exploitation.
Aims to democratize deep learning model design by enabling it on consumer-grade hardware.

stories.title: Encoder-Side Neuron Identification and Amplification for Acoustic Perception in Large Audio-Language Models
stories.author: Hung-yi Lee
bullet_points: The research addresses a limitation in Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs): poor performance on fine-grained, non-semantic speech attributes like emotion.
The proposed method focuses on an 'encoder-side' intervention, aiming to improve perception where acoustic information is initially extracted, rather than post-processing.
This approach seeks to enhance model capabilities at inference time without the high computational cost of full model retraining.

stories.title: Requential Coding: Pushing the Limits of Model Compression with Self-Generated Training Data
stories.author: Andrew Gordon Wilson
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'Prequential Coding' as a method to improve model compression.
It addresses a limitation of traditional parameter-based compression (like quantization) by focusing on data representation.
The core idea is that a model's ability to represent training data as a short code indicates underlying generalization capabilities.

stories.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
stories.author: Thomas Hofmann
bullet_points: Presents a theoretical framework to explain how Transformer models develop inductive reasoning abilities.
Studies a generalized class of inductive tasks, unifying various synthetic benchmarks like in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning.
The research theoretically proves that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined to a specific, generalized structure.

stories.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
stories.author: Preston Culbertson
bullet_points: Introduces REGRIND, a new minimalist pipeline for dexterous manipulation using Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Addresses the challenge of applying simple motion retargeting recipes (successful in whole-body control) to complex, contact-rich manipulation tasks.
Focuses on learning delicate regulation of contact modes and forces, which is crucial for dexterous tasks.

stories.title: Input-Aware Dynamic Backdoor Attack Against Quantum Neural Networks
stories.author: Rui Ning
bullet_points: The research addresses security vulnerabilities in Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs), a promising area for quantum machine learning.
It introduces an 'Input-Aware Dynamic Backdoor Attack,' moving beyond traditional fixed-trigger backdoor methods.
This dynamic approach is designed to circumvent existing defenses that target repetitive patterns left by static triggers.

stories.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
stories.author: Romain Amigon
bullet_points: Proposes a new, frugal Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework to reduce computational costs.
Combines a Transformer controller (trained via RL) for global search with local micro-exploitation.
Aims to democratize deep learning model design by enabling it on consumer-grade hardware.

stories.title: An Exact Instrument for State Usage in Selective State-Space Models, and the Input-Driven Migration It Reveals
stories.author: Raktim Bhattacharya
bullet_points: Introduces an exact measurement tool for understanding how Selective State-Space Models (like Mamba) utilize their internal modes.
Leverages the diagonal nature of the state matrix to allow for precise, offline calculation of output error when modes are dropped.
Provides a per-(layer, channel, window) Gram tensor to quantify the contribution of individual modes to the model's output.

stories.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Metacognition is identified as a critical, foundational component for advanced intelligence in AI.
The paper addresses the current gap in understanding how LLMs can exhibit or be endowed with effective metacognitive abilities.
The research highlights the need to explore how metacognitive skills can be adapted for future AI systems.

stories.title: AdvancedMathBench: A Benchmark Suite for Advanced Mathematical Proof Generation and Verification
stories.author: Kai Chen
bullet_points: Introduces AdvancedMathBench, a new benchmark suite designed to test LLMs on advanced mathematical proof generation and verification.
Addresses a gap in current benchmarks by focusing on the validity of the reasoning process, rather than just final-answer correctness.
Aims to improve the understanding of LLM capabilities in complex, advanced mathematical domains beyond high-school or Olympiad levels.

stories.title: How Temperature Shapes Ideological Discourse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation?
stories.author: Anderson Avila
bullet_points: The research investigates how temperature settings influence ideological discourse within Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
It highlights a gap in current LLM research: the impact of ideological bias transmitted via retrieved documents in RAG.
The study aims to determine if RAG systems transmit, amplify, or suppress ideological positions present in their source material.

stories.title: MET: Theory-Grounded and Culture-Aware Multilingual Moral Reasoning
stories.author: Lu Wang
bullet_points: Existing multilingual moral reasoning benchmarks fail because they rely on direct translation instead of adapting to culture-specific items.
Current inference-time methods for moral reasoning are limited by static, English-centric scaffolds and lack grounding in established moral theory.
Training approaches for moral decision-making are hindered by the high cost of obtaining necessary supervision data.

stories.title: STEP: Career-Path Recommendation via Temporal and Educational Trajectory Modeling
stories.author: Tijl De Bie
bullet_points: The research proposes 'STEP' to recommend career paths by modeling temporal and educational trajectories from resumes.
Resumes are recognized as a rich but challenging data source due to their unstructured, heterogeneous, and multilingual nature.
The work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to enable large-scale systematic analysis for workforce planning and job recommendations.

stories.title: Porting Gemma-4 (2B / 4B / 12B) to AWS Inferentia2
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: The article details the practical challenges of deploying Google's Gemma-4 models on AWS Inferentia2 hardware.
It highlights specific technical roadblocks encountered, including issues with mixed attention heads and limitations in existing optimization frameworks (vLLM, optimum-neuron, NxD).
The report serves as a valuable field study for engineers looking to optimize LLM inference on specialized AWS silicon.

stories.title: The LLM Thought a Dollar Was Still ₦450: Building a Car Pricing Engine for a Market With No Data
stories.author: chichebe_john_5b060931c73
bullet_points: The article details the development of an AI valuation engine specifically for the Nigerian used car market.
A key challenge highlighted is the lack of reliable historical data in the target market, forcing novel data handling approaches.
The project serves as a case study on applying LLMs/AI in data-scarce, real-world economic scenarios.
